newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Interphil declares 25 pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Interphil declares 25 pct stock dividend.

text.p: Interphil Laboratories Inc said on Tuesday its board declared a 25 percent stock dividend worth a total of 112.5 million pesos.
Last year, it did not pay any dividend.

In a letter to the Philippine Stock Exchange, Interphil said the record date for the stock dividend will be determined after the Securities and Exchange Commssion approves the increase in authorised capital stock to 900 million pesos from 450 million pesos.

Interphil is a third-party contract manufacturer of pharmaceutical and veterinary products. It produces products for leading multinational clients which account for 30 percent of the domestic pharmaceutical market.
